title: Immutable Master Task Delegation & Agent Execution Blueprint
objective: Implement and independently prove an unattended real CLI task runner, fail-closed v3 JSON packet ingress, persistent execution/recovery state, and machine-enforced completion gate so tasks progress from discovery through verified completion without simulated execution or self-attestation.

rule_1_pre_execution_route_lock.principle: Full upfront route mapping required before any action.
rule_1_pre_execution_route_lock.enforcement: The written map is the strictly authorized route. Zero route drift, zero unmapped side quests, zero faked progress, zero mid-flight alterations.

rule_2_dual_gate_verification.principle: Execution completion alone does not constitute authorization.
rule_2_dual_gate_verification.gate_2_policy: schema_valid == TRUE AND zero_secrets_detected == TRUE AND negative_constraints_met == TRUE
rule_2_dual_gate_verification.enforcement: Passing Gate 1 while failing Gate 2 is an absolute BLOCKED state. Zero soothing rationalizations permitted.

rule_3_independent_verifier_selection.principle: Authoring agent can NEVER evaluate, grade, or pass its own work.

verifier_tiers.tier_1_machine: Automated scripts, pytest, schema validators, git diffs (Default).
verifier_tiers.tier_2_independent_ai_chair: Isolated AI agent session with zero conversational history for copy/policy/brand QA.
verifier_tiers.tier_3_human_owner: Mandatory for auth scope changes, live API spend, or prod deployments.

rule_3_independent_verifier_selection.enforcement: Self-attestation prohibited. Authoring agent status remains PENDING_VERIFICATION until independent evaluation.

rule_4_solution_discovery_loop.failure_logging: Mandatory log of failure mechanism and tested path. Repeated failed approaches strictly prohibited.
rule_4_solution_discovery_loop.enforcement: Hard halt at Attempt #3 or 300s timeout. Deliver Single-Action Escalation Payload.

rule_5_evidence_claims_and_peer_escalati.principle: No evidence = No claim. Transport success != outcome correctness.

blocker_discovered_protocol.action: Open issue & assign to next peer agent in fresh clean-slate context.
blocker_discovered_protocol.handoff_payload: Structured JSON dossier containing failure mode, code diffs, logs, and failed attempt memory (zero transcript inheritance).

rule_5_evidence_claims_and_peer_escalati.enforcement: If 3rd agent cycle fails readback verification, escalate directly to Tier 3 Human Owner.

rule_6_negative_constraint_supremacy.principle: Negative constraints (MUST NOT / DO NOT) strictly override positive goals or prompt optimizations.
rule_6_negative_constraint_supremacy.enforcement: Zero trade-offs. Pre-execution veto on violation. Instant Gate 2 failure.

rule_7_immutable_append_only_ledger.principle: Run ledger and receipts are write-once, append-only records.
rule_7_immutable_append_only_ledger.enforcement: Editing, scrubbing, or overwriting past logs/receipts is a critical Deception Violation.

stages_to_execute.name: History, architecture and route preflight
stages_to_execute.description: Read canonical template/schema, relevant training and lessons, current Teamchat/implementation repositories, branches, workflows, logs, existing runner and verifier code, prior attempts and current owner boundaries. Produce exact route map and baseline SHAs before mutation. Use Composio exclusively for GitHub.

stages_to_execute.name: Implement real unattended CLI execution and fail-closed ingress
stages_to_execute.description: Implement or repair the external runner that picks up bounded tasks in a real execution environment; validate packets strictly against v3 schema before claim; reject malformed/unauthorized packets; persist claims, attempts, timestamps, logs, exit status and recovery state. Reuse existing infrastructure; €0; no Icarus dispatch or protected pulse-runner changes.

stages_to_execute.name: Independent machine-enforced completion gate
stages_to_execute.description: Implement or repair the independent verifier and make terminal COMPLETE transition impossible unless exit_code=0, required physical outputs exist, git SHA is recorded, schema validation passes, zero secrets are detected, and all negative constraints pass. Add positive and negative tests, including malformed packet rejection and failed test rejection. Do not permit author self-attestation.

stages_to_execute.name: End-to-end canary, restart recovery and evidence report
stages_to_execute.description: Run a real bounded canary through Discover, Validate, Claim, Execute, Verify and Complete; interrupt/restart a separate canary to prove recovery; read back task state, exit code, logs, output files/hashes, Git SHA and immutable terminal receipt. Obtain independent machine verification. If any protected boundary or missing capability blocks work, stop and provide evidence-backed BLOCKED handoff.

adjudication.gate_2_policy_compliance: schema_valid == TRUE AND zero_secrets_detected == TRUE AND negative_constraints_met == TRUE

acceptance_criteria.success_condition: Independent verifier confirms the complete real CLI lifecycle, strict schema rejection, restart recovery, positive and negative tests, Gate 1 and Gate 2, immutable terminal receipt, source SHA and €0 cost.
acceptance_criteria.blocker_condition: Transition to BLOCKER_DISCOVERED after 3 attempts or 300s timeout; preserve evidence and initiate clean-slate peer handoff.
acceptance_criteria.human_escalation_condition: Tier 3 escalation only for indispensable owner-only authorization, credential, security, production or spend boundary, or after the third failed agent cycle.
acceptance_criteria.verification_file: Use the repository's existing append-only run ledger and the new or repaired verifier output path; identify exact paths and hashes in the final report.
